NewsArticle.Title: Politics Enhancement
NewsArticle.Content: Empowering the Self-Governed Society Guard, Guard Captain, Demagogue, Burgess, Judge: New terms doubled to 2 real-life weeks. It does not affect terms of existing office holders. Exile requires some time, as it always has, but now it does not reduce the exiler's Political Clout. Burgess: Cloak or Pompadour (as shown here) is given; a regal, aristocratic fashion statement. Shadow Hunger: Political office holders may go within the dark crypt and converse with the living dead. At the office holder's bidding, an offender is clutched by his shadow hunger. When an Aisling becomes evil, their evil develops into a real presence. This presence, the shadow hunger, can be summoned. Upon summoning it destroys the evil Aisling. See [political features](http://www.darkages.com/2000/pics/index_feature.html) screenshot and all features.
